title: Blades of Glory
tagline: Two men, one pair of skates, plenty of snacks.
about: Two rival figure skaters banned from singles competition team up as the first all-male pairs team.
cue: Serve the snacks when Chazz and Jimmy first take the ice together.
faces: MONTREAL PAIRS FINAL. IRON LOTUS AT YOUR OWN RISK.
Soft salted pretzels baked golden, with mustard and cheese sauce
Garlic and chilli prawns grilled hot, piled on ice with lime
Crumbed chicken with passata, ham and mozzarella, chips and salad
Chips, squeaky curds and hot gravy, the Montreal final way
Vanilla ice cream dipped in white chocolate and rolled in coconut
Thick hot chocolate with peppermint, whipped cream and candy cane
Raise it to the Iron Lotus. Nobody lost a head.
Two men, one ice rink, and one very big cheese platter. I'm wearing sequins to dinner and nobody can stop me.
On the big screen tonight: The Iron Lotus move. Chazz Michael Michaels in sequins.
Prices subject to change. Blades of Glory, 2007. Images: TMDB.

    StartersRinkside soft pretzelsSoft salted pretzels baked golden, with mustard and cheese sauceHow to make it500g pizza dough3 tbsp bicarbonate of soda1 jar sea salt flakes30g butter1 jar American mustard200g cheese sauce1 L waterRoll the pizza dough into ropes and twist into pretzels.Dip each in the water simmering with the bicarb soda for 20 seconds, sprinkle with salt flakes and bake at 220°C for 12 minutes.Brush with the melted butter and serve with mustard and the cheese sauce.Fire and Ice prawnsGarlic and chilli prawns grilled hot, piled on ice with limeHow to make it600g green prawns3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil3 garlic cloves1 red chilli2 limesToss the peeled green prawns with the olive oil, the garlic cloves, the chopped red chilli and salt.Grill on high for 2 minutes a side.Pile over a platter of crushed ice and serve with lime wedges.MainsChampionship chicken parmigianaCrumbed chicken with passata, ham and mozzarella, chips and saladHow to make it2 chicken breasts50g plain flour2 eggs150g breadcrumbs200g passata4 slices of leg ham150g mozzarella1kg frozen chips1 bag salad leavesHalve the large chicken breasts into thin fillets.Crumb in flour, the eggs and the breadcrumbs and pan-fry until golden.Top with the passata, the ham and the grated mozzarella and bake at 200°C for 12 minutes.Serve with chips and salad.Montreal rinkside poutineChips, squeaky curds and hot gravy, the Montreal final wayHow to make it1.2kg potatoes, cut in thick chips3 tbsp vegetable oil40g butter3 tbsp plain flour500ml beef stock1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce300g cheese curds or torn fresh mozzarellaToss the chips in oil and salt and bake at 220°C, turning once, until crisp.Melt the butter, stir in the flour and cook until nutty brown.Whisk in the stock and Worcestershire and simmer until glossy and thick. Pepper it well.Pile the hot chips into bowls, scatter the curds and pour the hot gravy over.SweetsCoconut snowball ice cream ballsVanilla ice cream dipped in white chocolate and rolled in coconutHow to make it1 L vanilla ice cream200g white chocolate2 tbsp coconut oil100g desiccated coconutScoop the vanilla ice cream into balls and freeze for 1 hour.Melt the white chocolate with the coconut oil, dip each ball and roll straight away in the desiccated coconut.Freeze until serving.DrinksRinkside peppermint hot chocolateThick hot chocolate with peppermint, whipped cream and candy caneHow to make it1 L milk150g dark chocolate2 tbsp cocoa powder2 tbsp sugarpeppermint essence, to taste150ml thickened cream2 candy canesHeat the milk in a saucepan until steaming.Whisk in the chopped dark chocolate, the cocoa and the sugar until smooth and thick, about 4 minutes without boiling.Stir in a little peppermint essence.Whip the cream to soft peaks.Pour the chocolate into mugs, top with the cream and scatter with the crushed candy canes.Hot mulled wineRaise it to the Iron Lotus.
